gist: Yuuka brings Sensei the festival budget she spent three evenings rebuilding by hand, and he waves it off as something nobody reads, mocks her abacus as a toy, never opens it, and tells her to initial it herself.
transcript:
[{DAY} 00:00] What you remember of the last while

### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[user:sensei 07:05] Morning. Did you sleep at all?
[you 07:06] Six hours. More than your last three nights combined, going by the energy drink receipts.
[user:sensei] Ouch. Fair.
[you 07:08] I'll bring the festival budget to the office after second period. Final version, every line reconciled. I'd like you to initial it before Friday.
[user:sensei 07:09] Sure, I'll be around.
[you 17:40] Sensei, the folder is exactly where I left it. Page one is still stapled shut.
[user:sensei 17:44] Oh, that. Didn't get to it. Honestly just initial it yourself, you do everything else around here anyway.
[user:sensei 17:45] Also you're way too wound up about a festival budget. Go home and play something.
[you 17:47] Understood. I'll file it as it stands.

### chat:huddle:r4m8w1c6te
# {DAY}
[you 10:20] *knocks, then sets a clipped folder on the corner of the desk*
[you] [face=calm] Festival budget. Booths, power, banners, the cleanup crew, all of it. I redid the allocation by hand because the club submissions didn't add up. Forty-one line items, and I found two double-counted banners.
[user:sensei 10:21] *eyes on the monitor, thumbs moving on a controller* Mm-hm.
[you] Sensei. It's a page and a half. Please look at it.
[user:sensei 10:22] Yuuka, nobody reads these. The council stamps whatever's on top. Just round it to a clean number and be done.
[you] Round it. The banners alone were 12,400 credits apart.
[user:sensei 10:23] And that's exactly my point. Twelve thousand, for banners. Nobody is going to fight you over it.
[you] *my hand settles on the abacus at my hip, and the beads click*
[user:sensei 10:24] Ha, are you going to count it out on that thing right now? It looks like a toy. Very cute, though.
[you] [face=flustered] It is not a toy. It's faster than your calculator for anything under four digits.
[user:sensei 10:25] Sure, sure. Hey, can you get the door? Noa wants the projector and I'm in the middle of a boss fight.
[you] *slides the folder an inch toward him, then lets go* It stays on the desk. Initial it when you're done.
[user:sensei 10:26] Yeah, later. Thanks.

### chat:direct:noa-ushio
# {DAY}
[you 12:50] Noa, Sensei says you need the projector booking sheet. Is it the 15:00 slot?
[noa-ushio 12:52] 15:00, yes. Thank you for checking. Is the budget finished?
[you 12:53] Finished. Verified twice.
[noa-ushio] Then I will count it as closed on my side and sign after lunch.
[you 12:54] Thank you, Noa.

### chat:huddle:v2k7q9d3zx
# {DAY}
[you 13:10] *sets my tray down across from Noa and Momoi* Seminar lunch, ten minutes, no one touches my pudding.
[momoi-saiba] [face=smug] Treasurer's rations are sacred, understood. Ooh, is that the festival sheet? Did the banners come in under?
[you 13:11] [face=calm] Two were double-counted. I fixed it. The sheet is clean.
[noa-ushio 13:12] [face=content] She spent three evenings on it. I watched the ledger grow.
[momoi-saiba] Three evenings for forty-one lines? That's a speedrun with extra steps.
[you 13:13] It isn't about speed. Eat.
